product.summary: Biometric cold-wallet device that generates and stores private keys inside secure hardware and unlocks with fingerprint authentication.
product.notes: Current first-party storefront establishes an active purchasable biometric hardware wallet; exact initial launch date remains unresolved.

events.title: D'CENT Biometric Wallet added Cardano support
events.description: D'CENT announced Cardano (ADA) support for the Biometric Wallet through a firmware and mobile-app update path.
events.notes: This is a product capability/integration milestone. It is not treated as the D'CENT product launch date.

evidence.title: D'CENT Biometric Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party storefront lists the D'CENT Biometric Wallet for sale and describes its secure-element and fingerprint wallet boundary.

evidence.title: D'CENT Biometric Wallet Integrates Cardano (ADA)
evidence.notes: First-party D'CENT announcement of Cardano support for the Biometric Wallet and the associated firmware/app update path.
